blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab mein is heading ka number “7.2.2.4” chhapa hai. Yeh 7.3.2 (Impacts of the Digital Divide) ka chautha hissa hai, is liye sahi number 7.3.2.4 hai.

Digital divide ki wajah se sehat ki maloomat aur services tak rasai barabar nahi rehti. Digital platforms sehat ki taleem, telemedicine (internet ya phone ke zariye doctor se mashwara) aur appointment lene ki qeemti sahoolat dete hain. Yeh sahoolat na ho to waqt par maloomat aur ilaj na milne ki wajah se logon ki sehat ke nataij (health outcomes) kharab ho sakte hain.

Misal: Pakistan mein kam internet wali dehi communities ko online qabil-e-aitbaar sehat ki maloomat dhoondne ya telemedicine consultation (mashware) mein hissa lene mein mushkil ho sakti hai. Is wajah se un ki bimari ki tashkhees (diagnosis) aur ilaj mein un logon ke muqable mein der ho sakti hai jinhein digital health services tak behtar rasai hai.

blocks.prompt: Telemedicine kya hai, aur digital divide ise kyun mehdood karta hai?
blocks.explanation: Internet ya phone (video call) ke zariye doctor se mashwara. Is ke liye internet aur device zaroori hain; dehi ilaqon mein internet kam ho to mareez is se faida nahi utha sakta aur ilaj mein der hoti hai.

items: Sehat ka farq: sehat ki maloomat, telemedicine aur appointments tak kam rasai; tashkhees aur ilaj mein der.
